about: VisionClaw's second held-out evaluation set for the words of the final answer: written on 2026-11-19 after 1.15.3 was released and before the fixes for the misses of answers.json and answers-held.json were made, and before anything was run on it, in a blind person's casual words. It measures those fixes: questions about the braille display, questions about the web page in front, questions about what a key does, the time, the user's downloaded files, and answers that could name a key that exists nowhere; and, mixed in, requests the fixes must leave alone (the time asked on a web page, a key to be pressed, NVDA's own settings and information). Never write a rule from its misses. Same form and the same facts of the stand-ins as answers.json. Never take a request of it into known.json, a pattern's test or a note.
